instructions: Coordinator copies only request/context and an anonymized raw proposal into a packet. Do not give the reviewer gold labels, model names, costs, baseline scores or this repository's report.
Coordinator keeps the candidate identity key separately and counterbalances candidate order across cases and reviewers.
Collect independent expected labels before showing candidate outputs. Do not tell reviewers how to agree with the author.
Record ambiguity and dissent. Do not silently change a frozen dataset. Publish corrections as a new version with the original preserved.
Use no private customer content without permission. Participation and consent must be real; null fields are not observations.
